title: Mo & Krill + Bebop: hook Mo out mid-Combo
playstyle: Duo Mo for Bebop / Duo Bebop for Mo
question: Does hooking Mo during Combo keep the hold and bring the target, and is that better than hooking the target (Kieran's wording) or no hook?
hypothesis: H-B3-1.1 Combo survives a hook on Mo (no stun flag on the hook restriction; Combo breaks only on stun). H-B3-1.2 the held target arrives within 4m of Mo at Bebop. H-B3-1.3 Mo survives and the target dies within Combo + 3s kill check in >=4/5 trials vs <=1/5 without a hook. H-B3-1.4 hooking the TARGET instead fights Combo's spring drag and ends or shortens the hold.

arms.name: hook_mo
arms.notes: Bebop 15m behind Mo hooks Mo 0.3s after Combo starts

arms.name: hook_target
arms.notes: Bebop hooks the held enemy instead

setup.position: 3 bots clumped; Mo bursts in; Bebop 15m behind Mo, then repeat at 20m and 25m

controls: Cooldowns and HP reset between trials
Same boons/souls/ability points in both arms except the thing under test
Same bot heroes, HP and resists
procedure: Mo Burrows in and Combos the middle bot (Combo T3, 3.1s)
Bebop presses hook at Combo start + 0.3s per arm
Record: Combo channel still running after the pull (bool), distance Mo-target on arrival (m), time from Combo press to arrival (s), Mo HP left, target dead within Combo+3s (bool)
Repeat hook_mo at 15/20/25m to find the max distance with >=1.5s hold left

metrics.name: mo_survived_and_kill
metrics.how: kill feed + Mo alive at Combo+3s

decision.rule: SUPPORTS if hook_mo succeeds in >=4/5 and beats no_hook by >=3 trials. If hook_target beats hook_mo, switch both combo texts to 'hook the target'. If combo_kept is false in hook_mo, REFUTED: change the combo to hooking Mo after Combo ends (escape only) and revert Mo's Spirit Burn to Colossus.
